Build a monthly step growth curve on the engine's time axis

Source: R/green_roofs.R
make_growth_curve.Rd

Expands 12 monthly factors into the data.frame(time, value) layout the engine expects for //Kurven/* datasets: time in hours since simulation start (the first timestamp of the rain series), one support point per month boundary inside the simulated period, plus a terminal point at end_time_hours. The engine holds each value from its support point until the next one (step interpolation), so month boundaries are the correct support-point locations.

Usage

make_growth_curve(origin, end_time_hours, factors = default_growth_factors())

Arguments

origin

POSIXct/Date (or anything lubridate::as_datetime() accepts): the calendar timestamp of simulation hour 0, i.e. the first timestamp of the rain series fed to //Kurven/Regen.

end_time_hours

Numeric. End of the curve in hours since origin; pin this to max(timeseries_rain$time) exactly as the workflows already do for Growth_1 / Shading_1.

factors

Named numeric vector of length 12, January first (default default_growth_factors()).

Value

data.frame with columns time (hours since origin) and value, ready to be assigned to a //Kurven/* entry of an h5_read_values() list.

Examples

curve <- make_growth_curve("2011-01-01", end_time_hours = 2 * 8760)
head(curve)
#>   time value
#> 1    0  0.68
#> 2  744  0.68
#> 3 1416  0.68
#> 4 2160  1.01
#> 5 2880  1.18
#> 6 3624  1.35
